$comment: What the factory reads to run mold_v0 (.claude/scripts/lib/single_service.py). The codebase next to it is AUTHORED IN THIS REPOSITORY since the fork point below (operator decision D1, 2026-10-20; mold_v0-040), a recorded exception to 'never edit a mold in place' (MOLD.md). Every product-specific value the factory needs (env names, the service, its port) is still READ from the codebase's own files at plan time, so this file names paths and rules only.

source.$comment: in_tree: the codebase is edited here and never fetched, refreshed or rewritten by mold.py (lib/intree.py). since: the factory commit whose snapshot is the fork point. forked_from: the source commit that snapshot was taken at (the operator's product with mold_v0-031's hardening merged); nothing is ever fetched from it again. ci.workflow: the factory workflow whose run the deploy gate requires for the commit being deployed (lib/deploy_gate.py). null until mold_v0-001 adds it: until then the gate requires every check GitHub reports for that commit of this repository to have passed, and at least one to exist.

rls.$comment: The product's own row-level security proof (mold_v0-031; its scripts/check-rls.ts: the catalog, then a live probe in a rolled-back transaction). Applies only while the codebase's package.json has the script. Intake writes datastores.postgres.rls = mode; the deploy runs the script (compose_remote: in a one-off container of the new release, with the server's env file; vercel: on this machine against the api project's production database) and a failure is a failed health check; the lanes run it against an embedded throwaway database.

vercel.$comment: TWO projects on Vercel (operator's decision 2026-10-20, ticket mold_v0-029): <project>-api is the API and MCP function from the root vercel.json, the only one with the app's own Neon Postgres and the product's minted keys; <project> is the web console (web/, a server-rendered Next.js app behind a middleware) as its own Next.js project, given the API's address through the one variable its next.config reads (found there at plan time, never named here) and only the sign-in names below. Deployed api first; both rolled back if either fails its health.

not_needed.packs: mold_v0 is the operator's product pinned as it is (MOLD.md): it has no pack mechanism yet, so an app carries no code of its own
not_needed.brand: mold_v0 has no brand overlay yet (no branding/rules.json): the app keeps the product's own look until mold_v0 is generalised
not_needed.workspaces: mold_v0 has organisations of its own, made in its admin console or by its org:create script, not workspaces written from state
not_needed.package: the agent package is mold_v1's (an npm CLI for its chat); mold_v0 is reached from MCP clients through its connector URL
